name: Settings Panel
description: A dark account settings page with scroll-spy section nav, spring toggles, segmented controls, avatar upload, a typed-confirm danger zone and an unsaved-changes bar.

props.name: initialValues
props.description: Saved values to start from. Anything you change is compared against these to drive the unsaved-changes bar.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called on Save or ⌘S. Return a promise to keep the saving spinner up until it resolves. Defaults to a 900ms fake save.

props.name: usernamePrefix
props.description: Fixed prefix inside the username field.

props.name: email
props.description: Where notifications go; also used in the deletion confirmation.

props.name: timezoneOptions
props.description: Options for the time zone select.

props.name: bioLimit
props.description: Character limit for the bio, with a live counter.
